messages:
marcos: @kelsey quick follow-up on PO RWI-4729 — carrier just flagged customs valuation mismatch, vendor ETA slid to 10/Apr. Can you confirm replacement vs depot repair route? We need final AWB and CI for customs today.

kelsey (NexaSupply): hi marcos :wave: seeing that on our side too. ETA now 2025-04-10 (AMS). We can either ship replacements from our EU pool (faster, +6% unit uplift) or route failed units to our DE repair center (slower, ETA +5 days) and send refurbished back.

sophie-ops: preferences: avoid additional crossborder paperwork if possible. EU pool replacement sounds better but need approved declared value for CI to clear. What's the declared amount you're suggesting?

kelsey (NexaSupply): for replacement shipments we normally declare commercial value = invoice value. If you want lower "customs value" we can add a commercial proforma with reduced declared amount but that requires buyer sign-off (risk: duties/insurance change).

dave-procure: how much uplift for EU pool replacements? +6% is fine if leadtime wins, but confirm liability/insurance. Also, are loaners available to cover capacity gap on Dedicated pools while we wait?

kelsey (NexaSupply): uplift per unit = $420 (unit price base $7,000 -> $7,420). Transit insurance claim limit uses CI declared value. If you reduce declared value, insurance payout could be capped lower.

iris-legal: we can't reduce declared value below commercial invoice — that's a misdeclared value. Allowed options: 1) send full CI and accept duties, 2) file preferential tariff (if eligible), or 3) route via repair (no importation of new units). We need proforma only for temporary import under repair-in-place with ATA carnet maybe.

marcos: ok don't fake CI. What's ETA difference if we route to DE repair vs EU replacement? We need numbers to decide.

kelsey (NexaSupply): EU pool replacement: ship 2025-04-10, gateway AMS, 2 business days clearance -> in-hand 2025-04-12.
Repair route: forward failed units to DE depot (pickup 04/08), repair cycle 5 business days, return ship earliest 04/15 -> in-hand ~04/20.

sophie-ops: replacement wins for timeline. If procurement signs uplift, we can churn capacity. @dave-procure can you approve $420 per unit for 8 units? total uplift ~$3,360.

dave-procure: approve provisional uplift. I'll add PO amendment this afternoon. Also need AWB + CI ASAP so infra can schedule Dedicated pool capacity.

kelsey (NexaSupply): sending AWB + CI now. AWB: 123-45678901
Commercial Invoice refs:
- PO: RWI-4729
- SKU: H200-48GB x8
- Invoice value/unit: $7,000
- Currency: USD

ops-bot: Ticket INF-3247 created for customs clearance docs (linked: https://redwood.infra/t/INF-3247)

marcos: copying carrier tracking command: `/track 123-45678901` — if anything moves I'll ping. Thanks all :thumbsup:
